description: Budget for what the plugin assembly, Jellyfin.Plugin.JellyfinEnhanced.dll, embeds (client assets, pages, tag assets). embeddedBytes: the summed length of its manifest resources as embedded (a packed one at its packed length). The DLL is these plus about 3.1 MB of code. The budget counts the resources, not the DLL file, because gate T runs with coverage and the file on disk is then the instrumented copy (0.65 MB longer); the resources are the same bytes either way. Checked by tests/backend/Api/PackedResourcesTests.cs (gate T). It is a ratchet: lowering the limit needs no reason; a history entry that raises it must give one. `limits` is always the last history entry's.

history.change: perf-runtime: client text assets embedded packed (scripts/pack-embedded.mjs); measured on restructure/integration 09ec6381 with this change
